cols.t: Share of 5v5 goals scored by the team.
Corsi share: all shot attempts for / (for + against), 5v5.
PDO: 5v5 shooting % plus save %. Regresses toward 100.
Fenwick share: unblocked shot attempts for / (for + against), 5v5.
Share of 5v5 shifts starting in the offensive zone (neutral zone excluded).
